next_edition.label: 2027, theme 'Spellbound' (per a planning site citing the organiser)

attendance.note: Press-reported: Reno Gazette-Journal says 'Black Rock City drew 63,400 people in 2026' (Google snippet of RGJ Facebook post). Organiser About page still says 'a temporary city of more than 70,000 humans'.

audience.psychographics: Affluent, highly educated participatory art and camping community: 59% household income USD 150,000 or more, 41.4% bachelor's and 37.6% postgraduate degrees; 32.5% live in California and 18.5% outside the US and Canada; 28.4% at their first Burn. No corporate sponsorship.

add_sources.note: Organiser IG bio: 'Black Rock City, NV, August 30 - September 7'.
Google snippet: 'Black Rock City drew 63,400 people in 2026, but Burning Man leaders say the larger story is a worldwide culture reaching 1 million.'
Organiser About page: 'a temporary city of more than 70,000 humans' (general, undated).

Black Rock City Census 2025 sociodemographics: age bands, gender, income (30.2% USD 150k to 299k, 28.8% USD 300k+), education, residence (California 32.5%, Nevada 6.4%, other US 40.3%, Canada 2.3%, other 18.5%), 28.4% attended one Burn.
SF Chronicle on the preliminary 2025 census: 41% in their 30s, 69% white, 34% from California (Google snippet).
First-Timer's Guide (Google snippet): 'There is no corporate sponsorship.'
Contact form with topics including 'Year-Round Collaboration with BMP', 'Fundraising' and 'Press & Media'. Offices in San Francisco, Reno and Gerlach.
